title: Built an AI-assisted crypto signal scanner (paper trading) – looking for feedback
author: CalmPredator
selftext:
I’ve been building a crypto signal scanner with AI assistance for paper trading. I’m not selling anything or promoting a service. I’m looking for feedback on the strategy.

\*\*What it does\*\*    
• Scans Binance USDT pairs on the 4H timeframe    
• Scores each coin from 0-12    
• Rates signals as Strong Buy, Buy, Neutral, Sell or Skip    
• Automatically sets Stop Loss and Take Profit    
• Uses market filters to avoid weak conditions    
• Tracks paper trading performance

\*\*Entry Rules\*\*    
• Score: 7/12 or higher    
• Minimum Risk:Reward: 1.8:1    
• ADX below 20 = Skip    
• Risk per trade: 1%    
• Maximum open trades: 3

\*\*Indicators\*\*    
EMA, RSI, MACD, ADX, ATR, Volume, StochRSI, OBV, VWAP and candlestick patterns.

\*\*Paper Results (so far)\*\*    
• 10 closed trades    
• 3 Wins / 7 Losses    
• 30% Win Rate    
• Average win ≈ 3.4× average loss    
• Slightly profitable so far

I know few trades isn’t enough to prove an edge. I’ll evaluate it after at least 50-100 trades.

\*\*I’d appreciate your thoughts:\*\*    
Does the overall strategy make sense?    
What would you add to reduce false Strong Buy signals?    
Would weighting each coin based on historical performance improve the strategy or just create curve fitting?
